proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  change ∀ (a b F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → F ∣ a → F ∣ b → (M5.completeSignature a b N = F ↔ ∀ p : M5.BinaryPolynomial, Irreducible p → p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N / F → ¬ (F * p ∣ a ∧ F * p ∣ b))
  intro a b F N hN hFm hFN hFa hFb
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := hFm.ne_zero
  constructor
  · intro heq p hp hpQ hab
    have hpN : F * p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N :=
      (M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient F _ p hF0 hFN).mp hpQ
    have hd := M5.PolynomialExclusion.signature_contains a b (F * p) N hab.1 hab.2 hpN
    rw [heq] at hd
    have hpFF : p ∣ F / F :=
      (M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient F F p hF0 (dvd_refl F)).mpr hd
    apply hp.not_isUnit
    apply isUnit_of_dvd_one
    simpa [hF0] using hpFF
  · intro hex
    have hdiv : M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ a ∧ M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ b ∧ M5.completeSignature a b N ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N := by
      unfold M5.completeSignature
      repeat' apply And.intro
      all_goals
        first
        | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _
        | exact EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _
        | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
        | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
        | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
        | exact (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _).trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    have hM0 : M5.cyclicModulus N ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hc := congrArg (fun q : M5.BinaryPolynomial => q.coeff N) hz
      simpa [M5.cyclicModulus, hN.ne', Ne.symm hN.ne'] using hc
    have hG0 : M5.completeSignature a b N ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hM0
      have hd := hdiv.2.2
      rw [hz] at hd
      exact zero_dvd_iff.mp hd
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := M5.PolynomialExclusion.strict_divisor_extra_factor F (M5.completeSignature a b N) hFm (M5.PolynomialExclusion.signature_contains a b F N hFa hFb hFN) hG0 hne
    have hpQ : p ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N / F :=
      (M5.PolynomialExclusion.factor_dvd_quotient F _ p hF0 hFN).mpr (hpd.trans hdiv.2.2)
    exact hex p hp hpQ ⟨hpd.trans hdiv.1, hpd.trans hdiv.2.1⟩
